images.title: Wooden Driveway Gate
images.description: Front view of a stained wooden double driveway gate with arched top, strap hinges, and hardware.
images.demo_purpose: Difficult example — structure-level detection or zero detections may occur.

benchmark.object_definition: Count the driveway gate assembly as one gate (not individual pickets).

images.title: Wooden Picket Fence Panel
images.description: Isolated wooden picket fence segment with pointed tops against a plain background.
images.demo_purpose: Demonstrates prompt-based counting of an individual fence panel segment.

benchmark.object_definition: Count each individual fence panel segment visible in the photo.
